DOP: jaya mfn. and m. ( and n. ?) [ S. jaya, mfn. and m.; BHS also n. ], 1. ( mfn. ) conquering; winning ; — ifc see ajitañjaya ( sv jayati ); — 2. ( m.n. ) victory; winning ; Abh 402 (~o); 761 (~o jayanaṃ jiti); Vin IV 1, 23 (ete … titthiyo nāma yena kenaci jetabbā n’ eva tesaṃ ~o dātabbo ti); D I 10, 5 (imassa ~o bhavissati imassa parājayo bhavissati); S I 83, 32 (upasanto sukhaṃ seti hitvā ~aṃ parājayaṃ); 163, 29* (~aṃ c’ ev’ assa taṃ hoti yā titikkhā vijānato; Spk I 230, 4 : ass’ eva taṃ ~aṃ hoti, so ~o hotī ti attho); Sn 681 (yadā pi āsi asurehi saṅgamo ~o surānaṃ asurā parājitā); Th 70 (paññavā pana uttamo manussesu ca devesu sīlapaññāṇato ~aṃ; or part.pr. of jayati qv ; Th-a I 169, 22 foll. : sīlapaññāṇahetu paṭi-pakkhajayo kāmakilesajayo hotī ti attho) = 619 (Th-a II 261, 21 : ~an ti ca liṅgavippallāso daṭṭhabbo, ahū ti vā vacanaseso); Ja I 75, 5* (~o hi buddhassa sirīmato ayaṃ Mārassa ca pāpimato parājayo); II 11, 22* (sace yujjhitukāmo si ~aṃ samma dadāmi te); Mil 24, 26* (nissaṃsayaṃ parājayo mama ajja bhavissati ~o ca Nāgasenassa); Sp 907, 26 (tasmiṃ aṭṭapariyosāne bhikkhuniyā ~e pi parājaye pi saṅghādiseso); Mp II 270, 8 (so gantvā aṭṭaṃ katvā ~am eva pāpuṇi); Dhp-a II 228, 8 (yo pana kilesajayena attānaṃ jināti tassa ~o seyyo); Mhv 25:86; — °- kusuma , n. , a kind of plant or tree (with [pale] red blossoms?) ; Sp 1083, 25 (lohitikā ~-pupphavaṇṇā, Ee, Se so; Be, Ce jayasumana-); Mp I 198, 22 (~-vaṇṇaṃ candanasārapattaṃ, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee jayasumana-); Dhp-a IV 133, 2 (~-vaṇṇāni ’ssa akkhīni ahesuṃ, Be, Se so; Ce, Ee guñjavaṇṇāni); — see also jayasumana below ; — °- ggaha , °- ggāha , m. [jaya + gaha 2 , gāha 2 ], a winning catch (at dice) ; Ja IV 322, 27´ (kaṭaggaho ti … °-ggāho, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-ggaho) ≠ Ps III 117, 24 (kaṭaggaho ti °-ggāho, Be, Ee, Se so; Ce kaṭaggāho ti) ≠ Spk III 110, 3 (kaṭaggaho ti °-ggaho, Ee so; Be, Se kaṭaggāho ti °-ggāho; Ce kaṭaggāho ti basaggāho[?]) = Mp III 377, 14 ( eds kaṭaggāho ti °-ggāho) = Sadd 640, 6 (kaṭaggāho ti °-ggāho) ≠ Th-a II 195, 17 (kaṭaggaho ti … °-ggaho, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se °-ggāho); Ja VI 282, 25´ (°-ggāhaṃ gaṇhi); Nidd-a I 90, 14 (°-ggāhaṃ gahetvā); — °- nāda , m. , a roar of victory ; Mhv 25:93 (Bhalluke patite tasmiṃ ~o pavattatha); — °- pāna , n. , a drink of victory, a feasting to celebrate victory ; Abh 398 (raṇe jitassa sampānaṃ ~aṃ); Ja VI 392, 4 (sakalajambudīpe rajjaṃ gahetvā ~aṃ pivissāmā ti); Dhp-a I 193, 14 (tayo divase ~aṃ pivi); — °- sadda , m. , a shout of victory ; Sv 149, 4 ; — °- sumana , n. , a tree (with [pale] red blossoms); SAF: shoe flower, Pentapetes phoenicea L. ; Abh 575 (bandhuko ~aṃ); Ja V 163, 21 (~-pupphasadisena sīsena); Sv 482, 5 (~-pupphavaṇṇā paṇḍukambalasilā, Ce so; Ee ~-pupphakavaṇṇā; Be, Se jayakusumapuppha-) = Ps I 225, 31 ( Be, Ce, Ee so; Se jayakusuma-); Ps V 7, 6 (paṇḍu-kambalasilāyan ti rattakambalasilāyaṃ, tassā kira rattakambalass’ eva ~-puppharāsissa viya vaṇṇo, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se ~-puppharāsi viya vaṇṇo); Dhp-a I 17, 8 ; Bv-a 84, 26 (~-kusumasadisaṃ … celavitānaṃ bandhitvā); 86, 21 (~-kusumasadisavaṇṇaṃ dupaṭṭa-cīvaraṃ timaṇḍalaṃ paṭicchādetvā); — see also jaya-kusuma above ; — dujjaya , mfn. and m. 1. ( mfn. ) hard to conquer; hard to win ; S I 162, 30* (kuddhaṃ appaṭikujjhanto saṅgāmaṃ jeti ~aṃ) = Th 442; It 76, 6* (yo tvaṃ ~am ajjhabhū jetvāna maccuno senaṃ; It-a II 75, 5 foll. : pacurajanehi jetuṃ asakkuṇeyyaṃ kilesavāhiniṃ abhibhavi); Sv 666, 7 (na sunimmadayā ti … duppajahā ~ā ti attho, Be, Ee so; Ce omits; Se dujjahā ti); — 2. ( m. ) a poor victory, a false victory ; Kv-a 16, 15 (sakavādissa pana paravādinā chalavādaṃ nissāya paṭikammaṃ katvā attanā sādhito jayo ~o); — sujaya , m. , a good victory, a real victory ; Kv-a 16, 18 (paravādissa pana sakavādinā dhammavādaṃ nissāya … jayo ~o ti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se omits ).

jayaggāha.cp: masc. conquest; the lucky throw or lot.
jayaggāha.p: [Jaya+gāha] (pu) CL=8 be victorious in battle, win in competitive games (or) getting victorious in competition.
